source: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System)
application: Post-Harvest Crop Residue Burning & Thermal Anomaly Detection
description: Satellite-detected thermal anomalies associated with post-harvest straw burning (Kharif rice stubble burning in Nov-Dec and Rabi wheat/stover burning in April-May). Burning destroys organic matter, accelerates soil erosion, and releases bioavailable nitrogen as atmospheric pollution.

Rajshahi.conservationAlternative: In-situ straw mulching and zero-till seed drilling

Rangpur.conservationAlternative: Stover chopping for fodder and biochar composting

Khulna.conservationAlternative: Surface residue cover to suppress capillary salt accumulation

Dhaka.conservationAlternative: Mushroom cultivation substrate and biological incorporation

seasonalFireIndices.drivingFactor: Rapid turnaround window before Rabi pulse/wheat sowing
High ambient temperatures and dry stover burning
